content: Long-term studies have shown that PCSK9 inhibitors, when used in conjunction with statin therapy, can significantly reduce the incidence of cardiovascular events. This effect is particularly pronounced in individuals who are at high risk for cardiovascular disease. Large-scale research conducted under the auspices of the American Diabetes Association (ADA) supports these findings, highlighting the potential of PCSK9 inhibitors to provide additional cardiovascular protection beyond what is achieved with statins alone.
